decisions.reason: The trommel screen appears to have been positively received and further developed into the 518 FLEX, which fits our core screening portfolio and supports flexible, modular customer applications.
The AK mobile high-speed flail shredder line was still being actively updated for EU Stage V in 2019, indicating ongoing demand and strategic relevance in mobile waste and biomass processing.
The mobile high-speed grinder gained stronger standalone presentation after launch, suggesting market acceptance and a good fit with our mobile processing and international sales focus.

The stationary electric fine shredder was only briefly mentioned and then disappeared from the website, which suggests weak traction or a lower priority versus stronger stationary shredder products in the range.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredders remained prominently marketed and were described as setting benchmarks, making them a strong strategic product for tougher stationary recycling applications.
